title: Mitacs-Romanko Initiative Announces Skill-Graph Curriculum Framework
description: Researchers Chengyang Li and Eric Floro at Queen's University, supported by Profs. Yuri Romanko and Hyunjoong Kwon, unveiled a 'skill-graph curriculum framework' for AI education. The framework uses ML-driven clustering on 10,600+ job postings to identify in-demand skills. The unique system identifier is CURRGRAPH-2026.

title: Embedded LLMs for Educational Course Design
